notes: Compact islands: one base in Tórshavn (or Tórshavn + one night on Vágar/Eysturoy), 0–1 hotel moves, self-drive rental from Vágar Airport. Subsea tunnels carry tolls; Kalsoy and Mykines need ferries (Mykines books out and weather-cancels; landing/hiking fee). Near-24h June daylight: sunset/night timing irrelevant, stargazing impossible; many hikes on private land charge fees.

notes: Single base in Oaxaca centro, zero hotel moves; walking, taxis, colectivos and booked tours for Monte Albán and the valley. Muertos week is peak demand; cemetery vigils are night events, so late nights and gentle mornings. Hierve el Agua has intermittent community closures: verify-before-going with fallbacks.
